purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Jianhu

queries.query: Jianhu China official cadastral parcel map land registration GIS
queries.result: Found the official Jianhu County government and Yancheng procurement pages. They identify the local natural-resources and real-estate-registration custodians and a 2026 cadastral database/map compilation project, but no anonymous parcel geometry service was verified.

queries.query: 建湖县 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 官方
queries.result: Found the official Jianhu Natural Resources and Planning Bureau page, the Jianhu government notice about online real-estate registration services, and the county government-service portal. The local pages establish registration/cadastral responsibilities and service routes, but expose no bounded anonymous parcel ID+geometry response.

registryEvidence.basis: The official Jianhu County Natural Resources and Planning Bureau page assigns the county responsibility for unified natural-resource and real-estate title registration, cadastral surveys, real-estate surveying, data sharing, and registration information queries. The official 2026 procurement notice names the Jianhu County Real Estate Registration Center as purchaser for the county cadastral database and cadastral-map compilation project.

officialSources.observation: First-party bureau page states responsibility for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral survey, real-estate surveying, data sharing, and registration-information queries; gives the bureau address and phone.

First-party Yancheng finance/procurement notice for Jianhu County's 2026 state-owned construction-land cadastral database and cadastral-map compilation; identifies Jianhu County Real Estate Registration Center as purchaser and describes countywide work packages.
Official Jianhu government-service portal exposes an online real-estate one-window service route and county service listings.

Public Jiangsu real-estate one-window landing page retrieved successfully; its current HTML/linked JavaScript was inspected, but no anonymous parcel feature endpoint, parcel schema, or safe geometry response was exposed.

First-party county article says the registration center uses the online Su Xiaodeng one-window platform for consultation, appointment, application, query, and feedback; it does not publish parcel geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Jianhu County local natural-resources/registration custodian and official Jiangsu government-service routes.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous city-bounded parcel feature response was retrieved; no CRS, parcel schema, native parcel identity, or safe polygon sample was available.

remainingUncertainty: The county's cadastral database/map compilation is an official project, not an open parcel API. The public service portal may require an interactive workflow or authentication for queries. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used to force a parcel hit. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS-verification disablement, or unsafe owner/address/contact/titleholder/personal/tax/account fields were used.
